description.value: A forested campground on Vancouver Island's wild west coast midway between Ucluelet and Tofino, with private wooded sites, a hot tub, sauna, and on-site surf school — not on the beach but a short drive to Pacific Rim's surf breaks. Open April to mid-October only.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Surf Junction Campground is an active, family-owned campground near Pacific Rim National Park. Backpacker sites (no cars, 2 people max) serve as hiker/biker sites, confirmed on the rates page and in photo gallery. Amenities like free hot showers, laundry, covered cooking areas, potable water (Front Lot), and wetsuit drying stations are explicitly listed on the front page and FAQ. The camp store with coffee/espresso bar provides on-site food. Reservations are accepted online and by phone. Contact info on the website corroborates the OSM address and website URL; OSM lacks a phone number, which the website supplies.
concerns: OSM note states 'coordinates to be verified'; lat/lon may not be precise.
OSM has no phone number; website lists 250-726-7214 and toll-free 1-877-922-6722.
Seasonal operation only (approximately April through mid-October); closed in winter.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established campground with dedicated backpacker/no-car sites, free showers, laundry, covered shelter, and on-site store—an excellent fit for touring cyclists on the Pacific Rim route.
